description_for_human: Explore synthetic sales with interactive charts from a Foundry hosted analyst.
description_for_model: Retrieve sales analysis and interactive charts from the hosted agent. Use get_chart for natural-language requests and drill_chart for a complete structured ChartRequest. The gateway only forwards requests; the hosted agent generates all charts.

functions.name: get_chart
functions.description: Ask the hosted sales analyst to query data and return charts.

functions.name: drill_chart
functions.description: Ask the hosted analyst to render a structured ChartRequest.
